- Target variable: dn_dt (Rate of change of the free neutron population)
- Input features: t (time)
- Dynamic states: n (Free neutron population in the assembly); precursor_population (Effective concentration of delayed-neutron precursor nuclei)

dn_dt = (k_eff * (1 - delayed_neutron_fraction) - 1) * n / generation_time - reactivity_feedback_coefficient * n**2 / generation_time + precursor_decay_constant * precursor_population + delayed_source_rate * (1 - exp(-n / source_saturation_scale)) - fuel_burnup_coefficient * n * log(1 + n / burnup_reference_scale) - temperature_feedback_gain * n**2 / (generation_time * (1 + thermal_relaxation_scale / n))
